snippet.title: "누가 남이래? 출가외인이라며" 10년 수발한 올케를 남이라던 시누이, 말 한마디 없던 시어머니가 입을 열었다
snippet.description:
"나는 출가외인이라… 병원비는 올케가 알아서 해."

남편을 먼저 보내고도 10년 동안 시어머니를 모신 며느리 정희 씨.
시어머니가 쓰러져 석 달은 입원해야 한다는 말에도, 딸은 병원비 한 푼 내지 않고 돌아섭니다.
"10년도 했는데… 석 달이 뭐? 대수야?"

그날 밤 병실. 엄마가 깊이 잠든 줄 알고 딸이 전화를 겁니다.
"걱정 마. 엄마 거, 다 내 쪽으로 돌려놨어."

석 달 뒤, 퇴원 잔치 날.
"엄마는 좋은 요양원으로 모시고, 이 집은 정리하자."
"집은 자식 거야. 올케는 남이잖아!"

그때, 휠체어에 앉아 말 한마디 없던 엄마가 입을 엽니다.
"…누가 남이래?"

━━━━━━━━━━
10년 동안 곁을 지킨 며느리와, 출가외인이라며 등을 돌린 딸.
여러분에게 '진짜 가족'은 누구인가요? 댓글로 들려주세요.

snippet.description:
Persib Bikin sejarah baru kalahkan klub Australia di kandangnya dengan remotanda, Maung Bandung lolos ke 16 besar ACL 2 dengan gaya!
Persib Bandung tandang ke Australia menghadapi Melbourne Victory dalam lanjutan ACL 2. Sebuah partai yang menentukan bagi Persib untuk lolos ke 16 besar. snippet.title: Kalau bukan ASAP NUKLIR, ini asap apa??
snippet.description:
🔹 Rebus air, tutup pancinya dilubangin, uapnya muterin kincir. Sambung ke gulungan kawat di dalam magnet, jadilah generator.
🔹 Buat sekampung, panci jadi ketel dan kincir jadi turbin. Buat satu kota, batu baranya bisa habis ribuan ton sehari.
🔹 Jadi bahan bakarnya diganti uranium. Satu pelet sebesar ujung jari, tenaganya kira-kira setara satu ton batu bara.
🔹 Tenaganya keluar karena atomnya pecah, bukan karena dibakar. Air memperlambat neutron, batang kendali menyerap neutron biar reaksinya nggak kebablasan.
🔹 Air di sekitar batang jadi radioaktif, jadi dikurung di pipa sendiri. Panasnya dipindah ke air kedua lewat pembangkit uap, lalu air ketiga membuang panas di menara pendingin.

📌 Ternyata reaktor yang sudah dimatikan masih panas. Sisa pecahan atomnya terus ngeluarin panas, namanya panas peluruhan. Makanya airnya harus tetap dipompa.

💡 Yang ngepul dari menara pendingin itu uap air, bukan asap nuklir. Saat reaktor baru mati, panas peluruhannya masih sekitar 6–7% dari daya normal, dan setelah 1 jam sekitar 1,5%. Pengayaan menaikkan uranium yang gampang pecah dari sekitar 0,7% jadi 3,5–5%.

Pertama kali denger kata "nuklir", dari mana? 👇

📚 Sumber:
• NRC Reactor Concepts Manual: Nuclear Power for Electrical Generation, PWR Systems, The Fission Process and Heat Production
• U.S. Department of Energy: Nuclear 101; 5 Fast Facts (bahan bakar bekas)
• World Nuclear Association: Physics of Nuclear Energy
• NRC Glossary: Containment; Southern Nuclear: Nuclear Containment
Animasi: peragaan. Benda disederhanakan, gerak dipercepat, atom diperbesar. Warna ungu pada air radioaktif hanya warna peragaan; aslinya air itu bening.

snippet.title: 2026 Election Results: Democrats Win Control of House and Senate. What You Need to Know - November 4
snippet.description:
James Longman has the latest on the 2026 midterm election results as Democrats take control of both the House and Senate, flipping Republican seats in states including Texas, Michigan, Kansas and South Carolina. Voters delivered a major setback to President Trump, with the economy, inflation, high gas and grocery prices, the rising cost of living and the war in Iran among the biggest issues driving the election. Plus, historic victories for James Talarico and Abdul El-Sayed, President Trump claiming Republicans would have won in a landslide if he had been on the ballot, what Democratic control of Congress means for his agenda, and a wave of historic firsts across the country, along with more election news you need to know today.

00:49: MI EL-SAYED WINS: Democrat Abdul El-Sayed becomes the first Muslim elected to the U.S. Senate, beating Republican Mike Rogers.
01:33: TX TALARICO BEATS PAXTON: Democrat James Talarico beat Republican Ken Paxton, flipping a Senate seat that had been Republican for decades.
02:22: MAINE COLLINS CONCEDES: Senator Susan Collins conceded to Democrat Troy Jackson.
02:41: HAMILTON FLIPS KS SEAT: Democrat Adam Hamilton defeated Republican Senator Roger Marshall, ending a 94-year streak of Republican victories in Senate races.
02:59: SC DARLINE GRAHAM LOSES: Democrat Annie Andrews beat Republican Darlene Graham, flipping a Senate seat that had been Republican for decades.
03:50: MS TOO CLOSE: The Senate race is too close to call in Mississippi, with Democrats easily winning the House majority.
04:08: JEFFRIES NEXT SPEAKER?: Democratic leader Hakeem Jeffries is poised to become House speaker.
04:17: HOUSE OVERSIGHT CHAIR: "LAWYER UP": Incoming Chairman Democrat Robert Garcia has already sent a warning to the Trump administration.
04:48: TRUMP REACTION: The president said Democrats have already called him, saying they want to "work" with him.
05:52: GOV. ABBOTT LOSES TX: Democrats flipped the governor's office in Texas, with Gina Hinojos beating Republican Greg Abbott.
06:15: BYRON DONALDS WINS IN FL: Republican Congressman Byron Donalds will become the state's first Black governor.
06:30: HISTORIC FIRSTS: The first-ever Black female governor, Keisha Lance Bottoms, won in Georgia; Chris Pappas became the first openly gay senator; and Deb Haaland became the first Indigenous governor in U.S. history.

যুক্তরাষ্ট্রের সাথে যুদ্ধ বন্ধে চুক্তির সম্ভাবনা নাকচ করে দিয়েছেন ঢাকায় নিযুক্ত ইরানের রাষ্ট্রদূত ডক্টর জলিল রহীমি জাহানাবাদী। বলেন, সমঝোতা বলতে পূর্ণ আত্মসমর্পন বোঝে যুক্তরাষ্ট্র। তাই আবারো যুক্তরাষ্ট্র-ইসরাইল ও ইরান যুদ্ধের আশংকা করছে তেহরান। এ দফায় তারা পারমাণবিক আক্রমণ করত পারে উল্লেখ করে পাল্টা হামলার হুমকি দিচ্ছে ইরান। রাষ্ট্রদূত জানান, কেবল হুতি বিদ্রোহী নয়, যুক্তরাষ্ট্র-ইসরাইল বিরোধী সব পক্ষকে সব ধরণের সহযোগিতা করবেন তারা। হরমুজ প্রণালী দিয়ে বাংলাদেশসহ কোন দেশের  জাহাজের নিরাপত্তায় ইরানের কিছু করার নেই বলেও জানান তিনি।  (#mahfuzmishu)

Dr. Jalil Rahimi Jahanabadi, the Iranian Ambassador to Dhaka, has ruled out the possibility of an agreement to end the conflict with the United States. He stated that, from the U.S. perspective, an "agreement" is synonymous with "total surrender." Consequently, Tehran fears the prospect of a renewed conflict involving the United States, Israel, and Iran. Iran has warned that it would retaliate—potentially even with a nuclear strike—should it come under attack. The Ambassador further indicated that Iran would provide comprehensive support not only to the Houthi rebels but to all factions opposed to the United States and Israel. Additionally, he noted that Iran is in no position to guarantee the safety of vessels—including those from Bangladesh—passing through the Strait of Hormuz.

snippet.title: #ลมฟ้าอากาศ : เริ่มพรุ่งนี้ (5 พ.ย.) ไทยตอนบนอากาศแปรปรวน ใต้ฝนตกหนักถึงหนักมาก
snippet.description:
กรมอุตุนิยมวิทยา ออกประกาศฉบับที่ 7 เรื่อง อากาศแปรปรวนบริเวณประเทศไทยตอนบน และฝนตกหนักถึงหนักมากบริเวณภาคใต้ เริ่มมีผลกระทบตั้งแต่วันพรุ่งนี้ (5 พ.ย.) จนถึงวันที่ 9 พ.ย.69 โดยช่วงวันที่ 5-7 พ.ย. ประเทศไทยตอนบนจะมีสภาพอากาศแปรปรวน โดยมีฝนฟ้าคะนอง ลมกระโชกแรง ลูกเห็บตก และมีฝนตกหนักบางแห่ง ซึ่งจะมีผลกระทบบริเวณภาคอีสานก่อน ส่วนภาคเหนือ ภาคกลาง รวมทั้งกรุงเทพฯ-ปริมณฑล และภาคตะวันออก จะได้รับผลกระทบในระยะถัดไป 
.
จากนั้นช่วงวันที่ 7-9 พ.ย. บริเวณภาคใต้จะมีฝนเพิ่มขึ้นและมีฝนตกหนักหลายพื้นที่ รวมทั้งมีฝนตกหนักมากบางแห่ง ทั้งนี้ เนื่องจากมวลอากาศเย็นจากจีนอีกระลอกหนึ่งจะแผ่ปกคลุมประเทศไทยตอนบนและทะเลจีนใต้ ส่งผลให้ลมฝ่ายตะวันออกที่พัดปกคลุมประเทศไทยและอ่าวไทยมีกำลังแรงขึ้น
.
สำหรับคลื่นลมบริเวณทะเลอันดามันและอ่าวไทยในบริเวณที่มีฝนฟ้าคะนองจะมีคลื่นสูงมากกว่า 2 เมตร ขอให้ชาวเรือหลีกเลี่ยงการเดินเรือบริเวณที่มีฝนฟ้าคะนอง
.

snippet.title: LEGO Godzilla in the early review! #21375 #lego #rlfm #godzilla #gojira #legoideas
snippet.description:
The King of the Monsters in LEGO form! Set was provided by LEGO for the review | Sponsored

LEGO Ideas set #21375 Godzilla will be released on November 27th, 2026. It consists of 5363 pieces and costs 449.99 USD / 399.99 EUR / 1699,99 PLN.

What I like:
- It is absolutely huge and looks amazing on display, especially together with the Godzilla Logo and Footprint GWP
- The head, arms, wrists and fingers can be adjusted, and you can swap the tongue for the Heat Ray
- I really enjoyed the modular construction. There are a lot of interesting techniques throughout the build and assembling such a massive model in sections works really well
- The large plates attached around the body are secured properly, so they do not simply fall off. This was one of my biggest problems with the UCS AT AT, where a large section underneath could occasionally detach because it was held by just a few studs. I did not have that problem here
- The texture of the skin and dorsal fins works really well and gives the model a lot of detail even from a distance

What I don’t like:
- Because of the size and weight, articulation is quite limited. The legs are fixed, and even the tail has a fixed position. The instructions make you choose whether you want to build it pointing left or right
- A lot of the large modules are connected using small ball joints. Even without much articulation, the model is still difficult to move in one piece. My tail came off once even though I was carrying Godzilla quite carefully
- The Heat Ray feels a little small compared with the size of the model. I would love to see a much larger version reaching all the way down toward the ground
- The dorsal fins would look amazing in transparent blue. They would work perfectly with a light kit illuminating the back and Heat Ray

#LEGO #RLFM #Godzilla #LEGOIdeas #MonsterVerse

snippet.title: So wird deine Thai Curry Suppe endlich perfekt
snippet.description:
Wenig Lust zu kochen, aber richtig Lust auf Geschmack? Diese Dumplings landen in einer cremigen Thai-Curry-Sauce – mit knackigem Pak Choi und einem Spritzer Limette. In ca. 20 Minuten steht dein neues Feierabendessen auf dem Tisch. 🥟🥥

🍽️ Portionen: 2 | 🔥 Schwierigkeit: einfach

🧾 ZUTATEN
1 Packung vegane TK-Dumplings (ca. 400–450 g)
1 Dose vollfette Kokosmilch (400 ml)
300 ml Gemüsebrühe, bei Bedarf mehr
1 EL rote Thai-Currypaste (vegan)
15 g Ingwer, fein gerieben
2 Knoblauchzehen, fein gehackt
1 EL Sojasauce
1 EL Palmzucker oder Ahornsirup
Saft von ½ Limette
1 kleiner Pak Choi
Salz

👨🏽‍🍳 ZUBEREITUNG
1. Die Kokosmilchdose nicht schütteln. Den dickflüssigen Kokosanteil oben aus der Dose in einen Topf geben und bei mittlerer bis hoher Hitze etwa 3–5 Minuten einkochen, bis sich etwas Kokosöl absetzt. Je nach Kokosmilch kann das länger dauern. Trennt sie sich nicht, einfach mit dem nächsten Schritt weitermachen.
2. Ingwer und Knoblauch  etwa 30 Sekunden darin braten. Die Currypaste dazugeben und 1–2 Minuten unter Rühren anbraten. 
3. Die restliche Kokosmilch und Gemüsebrühe einrühren. Mit Sojasauce und Zucker würzen und 3–4 Minuten leicht köcheln lassen. Die Sauce soll cremig, aber gießbar sein.
4. Währenddessen die Dumplings nach Packungsanweisung separat zubereiten. Den Pak Choi längs halbieren, gründlich waschen und 1–2 Minuten in leicht gesalzenem Wasser blanchieren.
5. Die Curry-Sauce mit Limettensaft und bei Bedarf etwas Salz abschmecken. Dumplings und Pak Choi in tiefe Schalen geben und die heiße Sauce großzügig darübergießen.
